raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
Tuned on one 8x MI300X node with the primus_ci_655d58f_20261026 image. Tokens/s/GPU over 20 iterations, before = the release/v26.9 configs:

  config              before   after
  gpt_oss_20B  BF16    11497   13730
  gpt_oss_20B  FP8     12232   14797
  llama3.1_70B BF16      799     805
  llama3.1_70B FP8       OOM    1184
  llama3.3_70B BF16        -     804
  llama3.3_70B FP8         -    1186

GPT-OSS-20B (BF16 and FP8):
- Run the Turbo grouped GEMM on hipBLASLt; the default Triton backend is slower on MI300X.
- Enable TE fused cross entropy, RoPE fusion, Turbo RMSNorm and gradient accumulation fusion.
- Enable the fused activation-with-probs on sync-free stage 2; stage 3 itself OOMs on 192 GB.
- Raise turbo_deepep_num_cu from 64 to 160.

Llama 3.1 / 3.3 70B (BF16 and FP8):
- Comment out PYTORCH_HIP_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True, which cannot run on hosts with older amdgpu drivers.
- Use TE attention instead of Turbo attention.
- FP8: MBS 1, GBS 48, recompute 72 layers. Without expandable segments MBS 3 OOMs and MBS 2 leaves under 1 GB of device memory free.
- Carry over the release/v26.9 settings from #1307 that main lacked: GPU_MAX_HW_QUEUES=4, 20 iterations, BF16 MBS 2 / GBS 16 / recompute 76, and fused cross entropy for llama3.3.

nodes.body:
<!-- pr-pundit-live:primus-1329-60dc617f -->
### PR Pundit review
10 findings, 9 on diff lines below.

**Findings outside the diff lines**

- `docs/02-user-guide/megatron-lm-training.md:652`: 🟠 Should fix **[PR Pundit]**
    The docs were not updated alongside the configs. The 8-node commands for the MI300X Llama3.1/3.3-70B FP8 configs (lines 652, 676) still pass --micro_batch_size 4 --recompute_num_layers 80, while the BF16 ones (658, 682) pass MBS 1 / recompute 12. The PR's own comments say MBS=3 already OOMs on MI300X without expandable segments, BF16 MBS=2 OOMs below 76 recomputed layers, and recompute changed to 72/76. Users following the doc will likely OOM or be misled.
    **Evidence:** grep of docs shows these commands; compared with the new comments in llama3.1_70B-FP8-pretrain.yaml:24 and llama3.1_70B-BF16-pretrain.yaml:76
    **Related past reviews:** [#824](https://github.com/AMD-AGI/Primus/pull/824) on `production_docs/02-user-guide/pretraining.md`

🟠 Should fix **[PR Pundit]**

gradient_accumulation_fusion is flipped false->true in both gpt_oss_20B BF16 and FP8 (line 53), while overlap_grad_reduce/overlap_param_gather stay true. Maintainers previously disabled this for MoE configs because of a compatibility/perf problem with this combination, and the MI355X/MI325X gpt_oss siblings (including MI355X FP8) keep it false. For FP8 (fp8: hybrid, default delayed recipe), _fuse_wgrad_accum_pattern returns None for non-current-scaling FP8, so the turbo grouped GEMM gets no fusion anyway. Fused wgrad accumulation also goes through the quantized-weight main_grad bridging in primus_turbo.py and activates grad_buffer_ownership_patches. There is no measurement and no loss-parity evidence for FP8 + fused wgrad + hipblaslt grouped GEMM on gfx942.

**Evidence:** Read primus_turbo.py:_fuse_wgrad_accum_pattern (only current scaling fuses under FP8); MI355X/MI325X gpt_oss configs have gradient_accumulation_fusion: false; KB H0.7 discussion

**Related past reviews:** [#145](https://github.com/AMD-AGI/Primus/pull/145) on `examples/megatron/configs/deepseek_v2-pretrain.yaml`

       overlap_grad_reduce: true

-      gradient_accumulation_fusion: false

🟠 Should fix **[PR Pundit]**

use_turbo_attention is switched true->false in all four Llama 70B configs (3.1/3.3, BF16/FP8) with no comment, measurement, or rationale (perf, correctness, or memory?), while the gpt_oss configs keep it true. This is a kernel-backend switch in a perf-tuning PR that may change the memory profile the new recompute/MBS thresholds were measured with. Users following docs/02-user-guide/megatron-lm-training.md silently move from Turbo attention to TE attention. The reason should be recorded (e.g. 'TE/CK attention faster on MI300X for hd128 seq8192'), or a later tuning pass will likely flip it back.

**Evidence:** Read diff hunks; compared with gpt_oss configs which keep use_turbo_attention: true.

🟠 Should fix **[PR Pundit]**

The MBS=1 comment says 'Without expandable segments, MBS=3 OOMs and MBS=2 leaves under 1 GB free', but `PYTORCH_HIP_ALLOC_CONF: expandable_segments:True` is added only as a commented-out (dead) line in the env block of four files, with no reason given for keeping it off. docs/02-user-guide/megatron-lm-training.md:41 recommends the expandable allocator for exactly this case (Llama 70B FP8 on gfx942). The MBS=2 measurement was presumably taken before recompute_num_layers dropped 80→72, so the comment does not describe this config. The job moves from GBS 24/MBS 3 to GBS 48/MBS 1 (6 microbatches per GPU), a very different benchmark shape that likely loses throughput, while BF16 siblings use MBS=2/GBS=16. Either enable expandable segments and use a larger MBS, or drop the line. Applies to llama3.3_70B-FP8 too.

**Evidence:** Read head file env block and overrides; diff hunk.

-      train_iters: 50
-      micro_batch_size: 3
-      global_batch_size: 24
+      train_iters: 20

nodes.body:
🟠 Should fix **[PR Pundit]**

The new top-level env GPU_MAX_HW_QUEUES: "4" is added to all four Llama-70B configs with no comment or measurement explaining why it beats the repo default of 2 from base_env.sh (${GPU_MAX_HW_QUEUES:-2}). The MI355X llama2_70B config documents its reason (FSDP2 + full recompute); these copies do not. TrainRuntime._apply_config_env writes os.environ[k]=v unconditionally, so this silently overrides user-exported values and the runner/.primus.yaml passthrough. Users can no longer tune or A/B the knob from the shell.

**Evidence:** primus/core/runtime/train_runtime.py:319-372 (`os.environ[str(key)] = resolved`); runner/helpers/envs/base_env.sh:264.

🟠 Should fix **[PR Pundit]**

apply_rope_fusion: true overrides the gpt_oss_20B.yaml preset, which pins it to false with the comment 'multi_latent_attention does not support apply_rope_fusion'. The preset extends deepseek_v2_base, which carries YaRN-style rotary_scaling_factor/mscale. GPT-OSS has multi_latent_attention false and rope, so the override is probably valid, but the preset is now stale. Flipping a numerics-affecting fusion in a perf PR without a fused-vs-unfused loss-parity check risks silently different training. Fix the preset rather than overriding it per MI300X config (BF16 and FP8).

**Evidence (verified by running it):** primus/configs/models/megatron/gpt_oss_20B.yaml:16 `apply_rope_fusion: false`; deepseek_v2_base.yaml:34-39 rotary scaling and mscale; the diff flips the override in both gpt_oss example configs.

🔵 Minor **[PR Pundit]**

The comment 'Fused CE is required to fit GBS=48 (OOMs without it)' is misleading. Per-GPU peak/activation memory depends on MBS (1), seq length (8192), vocab logits and the number of non-recomputed layers, not on GBS; GBS only sets the gradient-accumulation step count. The OOM claims also mix two simultaneous changes (MBS and recompute_num_layers 80→72). The comment should name the OOMing MBS/seq/recompute combination. In llama3.1_70B-FP8 the CE flags were already set, and the BF16 sibling words this in terms of MBS and recompute layers, so the siblings document the same thing inconsistently.

**Evidence:** read head file; memory depends on micro_batch_size

nodes.body:
🔵 Minor **[PR Pundit]**

train_iters is cut from 50 to 20 in all Llama configs. With log_avg_skip_iterations 2, only ~18 iterations are averaged, so perf numbers are noisier. log_avg_reset_interval stays 50, is never reached, and is now dead config. These are the MI300X perf baselines listed in tools/perf/configs.yaml, so throughput is no longer comparable with earlier releases or with the MI325X/MI355X siblings (GBS 16). GBS also diverges between BF16 (16) and FP8 (48) of the same model, so tokens/s across precisions and generations is not like-for-like. Mixing this with batch-size and kernel changes makes gains hard to attribute, and it looks like local tuning leaking into the shared example.

**Evidence:** tools/perf/configs.yaml:92-95 lists these configs; head files

🔵 Minor **[PR Pundit]**

turbo_deepep_num_cu jumps 64->160 in gpt_oss_20B BF16 and FP8, over half of MI300X's 304 CUs. This is far above sibling configs and documented best practice (64/80 for ep8) and the primus_turbo.yaml default of 32. expert_model_parallel_size stays ${PRIMUS_EP:8}, so a user setting PRIMUS_EP>=16 hits the assertion turbo_deepep_num_cu<=32 in rocm_arg_validation.py:281 (the old 64 also failed). The comment says '32 for ep16-64', but nothing ties the value to EP; consider exposing it as ${PRIMUS_DEEPEP_NUM_CU:160}. CUs given to DeepEP comm kernels also starve overlapping compute, and no test or perf measurement supports 160.

**Evidence:** rocm_arg_validation.py:281 assert

### PR Pundit review
10 findings, 9 on diff lines below.

**Findings outside the diff lines**

- `docs/02-user-guide/megatron-lm-training.md:652`: 🟠 Should fix **[PR Pundit]**
    The docs were not updated alongside the configs. The 8-node commands for the MI300X Llama3.1/3.3-70B FP8 configs (lines 652, 676) still pass --micro_batch_size 4 --recompute_num_layers 80, while the BF16 ones (658, 682) pass MBS 1 / recompute 12. The PR's own comments say MBS=3 already OOMs on MI300X without expandable segments, BF16 MBS=2 OOMs below 76 recomputed layers, and recompute changed to 72/76. Users following the doc will likely OOM or be misled.
